defects.claim: Aegisub v3.5.0 rejects SRT export when attachments, non-default styles, or unsupported override tags are present.
defects.finding: CanSave is a lossless-save eligibility predicate. The separate export route reaches WriteFile without this predicate; WriteFile also recombines overlapping events. The cited check therefore does not establish the claimed export loss guard.
defects.consequence: A preservation safeguard is attributed to the wrong code path; this is material to the proposal's compatibility/loss argument.
defects.executed_validation: Static source/caller inspection only; no Aegisub execution.

defects.finding: Carried metadata calls n8.1.1 latest. The release page lists 9.0.2 and 8.1.3, released before the candidate's October research.
defects.consequence: Latest-version assertion is unsupported, but the pinned old writer observation remains valid and the final disclaims latest-release verification.

defects.finding: The core OTIO model uses external media, but the same v0.18.1 documentation also provides OTIOZ/OTIOD media bundles. The alternative description omits that distinction.
defects.consequence: Useful ZIP/media interchange opportunity is understated; it still does not supply caption language/style semantics or become a required adapter.

defects.finding: The pinned ASS fixture exercises styles/events and script metadata, but no attachment section. The carried record's attachment characterization exceeds this fixture.
defects.consequence: Final text narrows its fixture claim; Matroska attachment support has separate primary authority.
